hero.sub: Neke atu i te 100 ngā momo waehere pae i te wāhi kotahi. Kōwhiria he momo, tāurutia ō raraunga, ka tikiake i te atahanga.

types.title: Ngā momo waehere pae
types.sub: Ngā momo katoa e tautokona ana, kua whakarōpūtia ki te whakamahinga. Pātōhia he ingoa kia whakamahia ki te pūwaihanga.
how.title: Me pēhea te whakamahi
how.s1d: Kōwhiria te momo waehere pae e hiahiatia ana.
how.s2d: Patohia he kuputuhi, he URL, ngā taipitopito Wi-Fi, he hoapā, me ētahi atu. Whakakāngia te Kuhu nui kia waihanga i ngā waehere pae maha i te wā kotahi.
how.s3d: Whakatikahia te rahi me ngā tae, kātahi ka tikiake i tētahi PNG kounga teitei kua rite hei tā, hei tiri hoki.
faq.title: Ngā pātai auau
faq.q1: He kore utu a I Need Barcode?
faq.a1: Āe. Ka taea e koe te waihanga me te tikiake i te maha o ngā waehere pae e hiahia ana koe, kāore he rēhitatanga, kāore hoki he tohu wai.
faq.q2: Ko tēhea momo waehere pae me kōwhiri e au?
faq.a2: Whakamahia te QR Code mō ngā hono, te Wi-Fi, me ngā hoapā. Whakamahia te EAN-13, te UPC-A rānei mō ngā hua hokohoko, te Code 128 mō te tuku me te rārangi taonga, me te Data Matrix mō ngā tapanga iti.
faq.q3: Ka taea e au te whakamahi i ngā waehere pae mō te pakihi?
faq.a3: Āe. Nōu ngā atahanga ka waihangatia e koe hei whakamahi ki ngā hua, ki ngā takai, ki ngā tānga hoki. Mō te EAN me te UPC i ngā hua hokohoko, rēhitatia ō nama ki a GS1.
faq.q4: He aha e whakaatu hapa ai taku waehere pae?
faq.a4: He ture motuhake tō ia momo. Hei tauira, ka whakaae te EAN-13 ki ngā mati 12, 13 rānei anake. Pānuitia te karere hapa, ka whakatika i ō raraunga.
